use.flag: Build GTK3 GUI tray application for controlling the OLED display
Build and install the kernel module (asus_oled)
Compress installed kernel module with xz

pkgmetadata.longdescription: ASUS OLED display controller for G1/G2/G50 laptops. Includes kernel module, daemon service, and optional GTK3 GUI. Device: USB VID 0x0b05, PID 0x1726
